SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Midd: File No. 176/39.
S. C. REGISTRY
No. S.H. D. 9072
Symons 37
Date March 16th, 19 39.

REPORT

Subject. Missing British Eurasian - H.C. Davies.

Made by. D.S.I. Black. Forwarded by.

Sir,

At 11 a.m. 16-3-39 a telephone message was received
from Mr. D.J. Brown of the Shanghai Gas Co. stating
that a discrepancy had been discovered in the accounts
kept by Davies.

The undersigned interviewed Mr. Brown and learned
that during the yearly audit it was found that a deficit
of approximately $16,000 was found in the books kept
by Davies, but as he himself as a ledger clerk never
handled any cash they were at present unable to state
how the fraud had been perpetrated. Auditors were at
present scrutinizing the books to try and find the
actual method employed by Davies, and upon learning
the system Mr. Brown stated that he would inform this
Station adding that it might take two or three days
before the actual method employed could be found. Upon
receipt of this latter information an F.I.R. will be
made out and a detailed report submitted.

D.S.I.

Sen. Det. I/C.

D.D.O. "A".

FILE
Desb / Cos.
F.A. to D.C.

日期 1939年3月16日。

报告

事由：失踪的英籍欧亚混血儿 - H.C. Davies。

具报人：警探长 Black。转呈人：

先生，

1939年3月16日上午11时，接到上海煤气公司 D.J. Brown 先生的电话留言，称在 Davies 经管的账目中发现不符之处。

具报人会见了 Brown 先生，获悉在年度审计期间，发现 Davies 经管的账簿中存在约16,000美元的亏空，但由于他本人作为分类账 clerk（职员）从不接触现金，因此目前无法说明欺诈是如何实施的。审计员目前正在仔细审查账簿，试图找出 Davies 实际使用的手段，Brown 先生表示，一旦查明该手段，他将通知本巡捕房，并补充说可能需要两三天时间才能找到实际使用的方法。收到上述信息后，将填写正式报案记录（F.I.R.）并提交详细报告。

警探长

高级警探主管

“A”区副总监

归档
Desb / Cos.
F.A. 致 D.C.
3月19日

Further REPORT

Subject (in full) Missing British Eurasian - H.C. Davies.

Made by D.S.I. Black. Forwarded by

Sir,

Enquiries from the Japanese Consulate show that Davies sailed 3rd class on the "Shanghai Maru", and booked a single passage.

Mrs. Davies when interviewed stated that she did not know where he might be going to, and she had no previous knowledge of his intention to depart.

Mr. D.J. Brown of the Gas Co. was informed of the result of enquiries. On the question of debts Mr. Brown stated that Davies had withdrawn about 75% of his Superannuation Fund to pay urgent debts and he knew that he was still heavily involved.

INDUSTRY
Louza Station
REPORT
Date March 6th, 19 39.
Subject Missing British Eurasian - H.C. Davies.
Made by D.S.I. Black Forwarded by

Sir,
At 9.30.a.m. 4-3-39, a telephone message was received from Mr. D.J. Brown, Secretary of the Shanghai Gas Co., Yu Ya Ching Road reporting a foreign member of the staff missing.
D.S. Wright attended and learned that Mr. Henry Charles Davies a British Eurasian who had been employed by the Company for 25 years as a ledger clerk had failed to report for duty since 28-2-39 and that enquiries from his wife showed he had not returned to his home Apartment 2, 1265 Rue Lafayette since leaving at 8.a.m. 28-2-39.
Enquiries at the Gas Co. showed that Davies left there at 5.p.m. 28-2-39 and has not been seen since.
It was mentioned by Mr. Brown that the missing person was friendly with two other foreigners, Schultz and Forrest who reside in flat 709 Embankment Building, North Soochow Road. As a result of this the two men were interviewed on 5-3-39 but both denied knowledge of his present whereabouts Schultz stated that Davies had promised to meet him at 5.30.p.m. 28-2-39 but had failed to make the appointment.
Mr. Forrest stated that he only knew Davies through the mutual friendship of their respective wives. He volunteered the information that Davies was heavily in debt that he owed his brother-in-law a Mr. Williams who was an Army Contractor resident in Tientsin $17,000.00.
A shroff employed by the Gas Co. one Tai Hoong

报告
日期 1939年3月6日。
事由：失踪的英籍欧亚混血儿 - H.C. Davies。
具报人：警探长 Black 转呈人：

先生，
1939年3月4日上午9时30分，接到霞飞路上海煤气公司秘书 D.J. Brown 先生的电话留言，报告一名外籍职员失踪。
警探 Wright 前往处理，获悉英籍欧亚混血儿 Henry Charles Davies 先生受雇于该公司担任分类账 clerk（职员）已达25年，自1939年2月28日起未上班报到，且向其妻子查询显示，他自2月28日上午8时离开后，未返回位于拉斐德路1265号2室的住所。
向煤气公司查询显示，Davies 于1939年2月28日下午5时离开该公司，此后无人见过他。
Brown 先生提到，失踪者与另外两名外国人 Schultz 和 Forrest 关系友好，后者居住在苏州河北路堤岸大厦709室。因此，这两名男子于1939年3月5日接受了询问，但两人都否认知道其当前下落。Schultz 表示，Davies 曾答应于1939年2月28日下午5时30分与他见面，但未赴约。
Forrest 先生表示，他只是通过各自妻子的友谊才认识 Davies。他主动提供信息称，Davies 债台高筑，欠其住在天津的陆军承包商兄弟-in-law（姻亲）Williams 先生17,000.00美元。
煤气公司雇用的一名收银员 Tai Hoong

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科）
（批注：DS6 / 注意 / J.R. / P.A. 致 C.C. (特务科) / 3月7日）
归档

Man: (戴宏亮) residin_ at 81 Alabaster Road was interview-
ed by detectives. He had been in the habit of loaning
Davies money for the past ten years and on 25-2-39 Davies
borrowed $340.00 with a promise that he would return it in
about 5 days time but had not returned same.
Enquiries as to the personal habits of Davies show
that while taking a drink he was not a heavy drinker, he
occasionally went to the Canidrome, he was seen at the
latter place on 27-2-39 by Mr. Sadler, another employee of
the Gas Co.
Enquiries were made at bars and cabarets in the
Settlement and French Concession but the only place where
he was known was the "Del Conte" Bar on Bubbling Well
Road where he owed a number of chits for drinks supplied.
The doorman of Mumm's Cafe, _ue Chu Pao San, when
shown the photograph of the missing man stated that he had
seen a person very similar, passing the door of the cafe
about 2.a.m. 1-3-39, he was not however positive in his
identification.
At 5.p.m. 6-3-39, D.S. Hocking (S.B.) telephoned
the Station and stated that on perusing shipping lists he
found that Mr. H.C. Davies had sailed for Japan via the
"Shanghai Maru" on 2-3-39.
Mrs.Davies will be informed of this on 7-3-39 as
she was not at home when detectives visited there at 6.p.m.
6-3-39.

报告
日期 1939年3月6日。
事由..
具报人................................转呈人................................
男子：(戴宏亮) 居住于阿拉巴斯特路81号，接受了警探的询问。过去十年间，他习惯借钱给 Davies，1939年2月25日，Davies 借了340.00美元，承诺约5天后归还，但至今未还。
对 Davies 个人习惯的查询显示，虽然他喝酒，但并非酗酒者，他偶尔去跑狗场，煤气公司的另一名雇员 Sadler 先生于1939年2月27日在该处见过他。
在公共租界和法租界的酒吧及歌舞厅进行了查询，但唯一知道他的地方是静安寺路的“Del Conte”酒吧，他在那里欠下多张供应酒水的签单。
慕尔咖啡馆的门卫 _ue Chu Pao San（原文不清，音译：朱宝三?），在出示失踪者照片后表示，他在1939年3月1日凌晨2点左右，看到一个非常相似的人经过咖啡馆门口，但他不能确定就是此人。
1939年3月6日下午5时，警探 Hocking (特务科) 打电话给巡捕房，称在查阅船运名单后发现，H.C. Davies 先生已于1939年3月2日乘坐“上海丸”号轮前往日本。
Davies 夫人将于1939年3月7日获知此事，因为警探在1939年3月6日下午6时前往其住所时，她不在家。
W.B.Shaw.
警探长
副本直送特务科。
高级警探 J.G Lousa.

（ circulated / 传阅）

下午12时45分。来自法国警察。自1939年3月3日起失踪，一名名为 Patrick Kelly 的美国男性，53岁，前美国海军退伍军人。
（传阅）

（传阅）
